Synopsis:
Default dialogue with hag spy, a redcap in dsiguise sent by the hag to spy on hag survivors. He is cold and accusatory to the player, trying to throw the player off the scent of the doll (that he sent). If Mayrina is present, Jatlo has used the doll to hex her and turn her into a sheep. If Mayrina isn't present, he's using it to pop up, scare, and generally torment the other hag survivors.

- LOW_HagSurvivors_HagSpy.json: A redcap in hag disguise has been planted among the hag survivors as a spy. He sent a bewitched doll that taunts and scares the others — if Mayrina is present the doll was used to hex her into a sheep; if she isn’t, it merely pops up to torment the survivors. The spy is cold, accusatory, and tries to deflect blame onto the player to hide his role in the doll’s mischief. The narrator’s note that he looks like one of the hags but “smells of blood and moss” hints that his disguise is imperfect. The player has arrived either to investigate or to help Mayrina and is being watched and questioned by this suspicious spy.

The hag support group is made up of people who have survived an encouter with a hag, and who have banded together to try to research hags, but also to be there for one another. However, one of their group (the dragonborn), is secretly a redcap and is toying with their minds. The redcap has also, if Mayrina is present, hexed her and turned her into a sheep. context: The scene takes place in a hag–survivors support group where a redcap spy, Jatlo, is disguised as one of the hags and has been planted to watch and toy with the others. Jatlo sent a bewitched doll that taunts and pops up to frighten the group; if Mayrina is present the doll was used to hex her into a sheep. Jatlo is cold and openly accusatory, trying to deflect blame onto the player to hide his role, and his disguise shows signs of being wrong — he “looks like one of your own, but smells of blood and moss.” The player has arrived either to investigate or to help Mayrina and is being closely watched and questioned.
